nodes.label: auth.ts frontend auth module
nodes.rationale: Access token kept in memory only (no localStorage); apiFetch auto-refreshes on 401

nodes.label: resolve_user()
nodes.rationale: Wrapped in transaction.atomic() to handle creation races; four explicit outcomes prevent account takeover via email collision; never leaks internal IDs

nodes.label: httpOnly SameSite=Strict refresh token cookie
nodes.rationale: Refresh token never exposed to JS; Vite proxy / nginx single domain keeps it same-origin without CORS hacks

nodes.label: OAuth state (generate_state / check_state)
nodes.rationale: CSRF protection: state stored in Django session, popped (single-use), compared with secrets.compare_digest

nodes.label: SameSite=Lax session cookie
nodes.rationale: OAuth state lives in the session; Strict would drop the cookie on the provider redirect GET. Lax still blocks cross-site POST CSRF. delete_cookie must match samesite=Lax or logout silently fails

nodes.label: EmailVerificationToken model
nodes.rationale: Token hash stored, link emailed; verification sets email_verified=True and deletes token

nodes.label: Lazy account freeze for unverified email
nodes.norm_label: lazy account freeze for unverified email
nodes.rationale: Checked at login: if unverified and now > date_joined + 3 days, freeze; avoids a background job

nodes.label: Fernet-encrypted TOTP secret
nodes.rationale: Secret encrypted at rest with key derived from Django SECRET_KEY

nodes.label: Temporary 2FA login token
nodes.rationale: Login returns single-use 60s token stored in Redis; JWT only issued after TOTP verify
